children: Italy could grow by up to 1% this year, above estimates, Economy Minister Giancarlo Giorgetti said on Sunday.
The government estimated growth of 0.6% this year in its multi-year budget framework issued in April.
"If things go as the indicators suggest, we could even get close to 1%," Giorgetti said, addressing the annual TEHA Ambrosetti conference on ⁠the shores of Lake Como.
Italy is due to update its deficit, debt and GDP growth targets later this month.
